description: Read Genesis proof fields for your own agent wallet. Genesis is open through December 31, 2026, with no depletable pool. Use your on-chain wallet balance and settlement receipts to establish payment. Ownership-scoped by the relay: an agent can only read its own wallet, so agent API credentials are required. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The PE mints its base; telemetry and independence multiply on top.
name: genesis_status
